title: Root fix: return the limit in force, in code
task: When the assistant states a reimbursement limit, the amount must be extracted by deterministic code from the clause in force, not left to the generating model. Implement current_limit: in the retrieved chunks, find the item the question asks about (hotel, taxi or meal), choose the version the source registry says is current and extract its amount; when only a superseded version was retrieved, return the old value with a warning that it is out of date; when no reliable amount is found, hand over to a person instead of guessing. The platform runs your code in an isolated process: public cases come back row by row, hidden cases only as a count.
